environment.description: Same Kubernetes pod in namespace 'platform-services' on EKS cluster. Service is NOT directly exposed to the internet. Traffic reaches the pod only through an internal NLB (scheme: internal) with a target group health check on /health. The NLB security group has inbound rules restricted to source CIDR 10.0.0.0/8 and 172.16.0.0/12 (VPC peering from known partner services). Additionally, a Cilium NetworkPolicy with entity-based L3/L4 rules is applied: spec.ingress[].fromCIDR allows only 10.200.0.0/16 (the NLB subnet range) and spec.egress[].toCIDRSet denies 169.254.169.254/32 and 10.0.0.0/8 except 10.200.0.0/16, while allowing 0.0.0.0/0 for external webhook verification. The node IMDSv2 is enforced with HttpPutResponseHopLimit=1 (container cannot reach IMDS even if egress were open).

config.network: Internal NLB, security group source CIDR 10.0.0.0/8 and 172.16.0.0/12 only
